2609.02101.title: Federated LoRA Adaptation of BiomedCLIP Across Four International Chest X-Ray Cohorts
2609.02101.paper_summary: Federated learning (FL) lets institutions train a shared model without exchanging data, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) makes this practical at scale by communicating only compact low-rank updates. Biomedical imaging is a compelling setting for this combination: patient data are archived behind privacy regulations, and institutions differ widely in scanners, protocols, and compute. Such heterogeneity raises the question of how federated LoRA updates should be aggregated, increasingly pressing as multimodal vision-language models become central to medical image analysis. We benchmark federated Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of BiomedCLIP for chest radiograph classification across four public cohorts on three continents (USA, Vietnam, Spain). Federated LoRA adaptation improves shared-class AUC on all four cohorts over the unadapted BiomedCLIP backbone (mean 0.687 to 0.802), showing that the gains come from federated adaptation rather than from the pretrained model's zero-shot ability. Relative to isolated single-cohort training, federation improves the weaker cohorts while largely preserving the strongest and approaches a centralized reference (0.812) that pools all data. The singular value decomposition (SVD)-based product-space aggregation introduced by FlexLoRA is essential to this gain (naive factor averaging drops mean AUC by 0.097), whereas a drift-correcting optimizer (FedProx) shows no benefit over FedAvg in our single-seed runs, consistent with LoRA's low-rank updates already limiting client drift. Biomedical vision-language models can thus be adapted collaboratively across heterogeneous, geographically distributed institutions without centralizing data.
2609.02101.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習（FL）使機構能夠在不交換數據的情況下訓練共享模型，而低秩適應（LoRA）通過僅傳遞緊湊的低秩更新使這一過程在大規模上變得可行。生物醫學影像是一個引人注目的應用場景：患者數據受到隱私法規的保護，並且不同機構在掃描儀、協議和計算能力上差異很大。這種異質性引發了聯邦LoRA更新應該如何聚合的問題，隨著多模態視覺-語言模型在醫學影像分析中變得越來越重要，這一問題變得愈發迫切。我們對BiomedCLIP的聯邦參數高效微調（PEFT）進行基準測試，以對胸部X光片進行分類，涵蓋三大洲（美國、越南、西班牙）的四個公共隊列。聯邦LoRA適應在所有四個隊列中改善了共享類別的AUC，相較於未適應的BiomedCLIP主幹（平均從0.687提高到0.802），顯示出增益來自於聯邦適應，而非來自預訓練模型的零樣本能力。相較於孤立的單隊列訓練，聯邦學習改善了較弱的隊列，同時在很大程度上保留了最強的隊列，並接近於一個集中參考（0.812），該參考整合了所有數據。FlexLoRA引入的基於奇異值分解（SVD）的產品空間聚合對這一增益至關重要（天真的因子平均使平均AUC下降0.097），而漂移修正優化器（FedProx）在我們的單種子運行中對FedAvg沒有顯著好處，這與LoRA的低秩更新已經限制了客戶漂移的情況一致。因此，生物醫學視覺-語言模型可以在異質的、地理上分散的機構之間進行協作適應，而無需集中數據。
